title: Black-market markup players can read
summary: Players now see how steep a black-market vendor's prices are: a description from Fair Deal through Slightly Above Average, Pricey and Steep to Highway Robbery, on the shop card and in Why this price?.
items: The DM can show players the exact percent instead, beside the Black market toggle or in Economic rules.
The DM always sees the percent and which description players get, and the vendor rules preview it while the premium is edited.
